p1.project: Project 1: Smart Leave & Absence Management System (SLAMS)

api_routes.exemption_reason: Email one-click manager approval webhook authenticated via cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 token and single-use nonce

iam_wildcard_findings.role: Default Lambda Role / Initial Execution Role
iam_wildcard_findings.finding: Overly permissive AWS managed policies (AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess, AWSStepFunctionsFullAccess, AmazonSNSFullAccess) and wildcard Action: '*' and Resource: '*'
iam_wildcard_findings.remediation: Replaced with granular IAM policies restricting DynamoDB actions per table ARN, Secrets Manager GetSecretValue on specific secret ARN, and State Machine StartExecution / SendTaskSuccess.

storage_security.s3_public_access: All 4 Public Access Block flags enabled
storage_security.s3_tls_enforcement: Bucket policy with aws:SecureTransport: false Deny

api_routes.exemption_reason: Public certificate verification registry for employers and third parties to validate issued certificates

findings.remediation: Restricted IdentityName to parameter-driven verified sender ARN: arn:aws:ses:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identity/${SenderEmail}

findings.finding: PointInTimeRecoverySpecification not explicitly configured (PITR disabled by default)
findings.remediation: Added PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: { PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true } to all 3 tables

findings.finding: Missing explicit BucketEncryption configuration in SAM template
No Cognito Authorizer configured on API Gateway; quiz and grading endpoints lack authentication
findings.remediation: Configured Cognito UserPool & UserPoolClient, added CognitoAuthorizer to REST API, and attached it to /courses/{course_id}/quiz and /courses/{course_id}/quiz/submit while keeping /verify/{cert_id} as a documented public exemption

p3.project: Project 3: Smart Employee Onboarding & Identity Service

findings.finding: DynamoDB PITR not enabled in template
API Gateway OnboardingAPI routes (/submit, /progress/{employee_id}, /admin/pipeline) lack Cognito Authorizer binding
findings.remediation: Configured CognitoAuthorizer on OnboardingAPI referencing EmployeeUserPool, enforcing HRAdmins group on /submit and /admin/pipeline

api_routes.exemption_reason: Automated uptime health check and synthetic latency monitoring

documented_exceptions.reason: AWS Textract synchronous and asynchronous document analysis actions do not support resource-level permissions (ARNs). Requires Resource: '*'. Constrained with Condition: StringEquals aws:PrincipalAccount: ${AWS::AccountId}.

AWS Comprehend pre-trained entity and phrase detection APIs operate on ephemeral in-memory payload strings and do not support resource-level permissions. Requires Resource: '*'. Constrained with Condition: StringEquals aws:PrincipalAccount: ${AWS::AccountId}.

findings.finding: SES identity policy uses trailing wildcard identity/*
findings.remediation: Scoped down to exact verified email ARN: arn:aws:ses:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identity/${SesSourceEmail}

trusted_advisor.details: All 5 S3 buckets (slams-frontend-hosting, CertificatesBucket, EmployeeDocumentsBucket, ResumeBucket, FrontendBucket) have explicit PublicAccessBlockConfiguration with all 4 flags set to true. No public ACLs or open bucket policies detected.

100% serverless microservice architecture. Compute relies entirely on AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, SQS, and Step Functions. No EC2 instances, bastion hosts, or VPC security groups with 0.0.0.0/0 ingress on ports 22, 3389, or database ports.

Audited 17 Lambda execution roles across all 4 projects. Eliminated wildcard admin policies (*:*), scoped DynamoDB actions to specific table ARNs, scoped S3 actions to specific key prefixes, scoped SES/SNS to specific ARNs, and documented Textract/Comprehend exceptions.
Root account MFA is enabled with a hardware/virtual TOTP token. Daily deployment and administration operate strictly through IAM administrative users / IAM roles with temporary STS credentials.

Finding: Secret 'smart-leave/approval-token' in Project 1 stores HMAC signing secret without automated Lambda rotation. Resolution: Added AWS Secrets Manager rotation Lambda hook configured for 90-day automatic key rotation with zero-downtime dual-key validation.

Finding: Project 2 (QuizzesTable, CompletionsTable, CertificatesTable) and Project 3 (EmployeeOnboardingTable) initially lacked explicit PITR configuration. Resolution: Hardened templates and deployment scripts to enforce PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true across all 10 tables, protecting against accidental data deletion or corruption.

trusted_advisor.check: Amazon S3 Bucket Versioning & Lifecycle Rules
trusted_advisor.details: Finding: ResumeBucket and CertificatesBucket had versioning unconfigured, presenting data loss risk. Resolution: Hardened S3 configuration to enable VersioningConfiguration: Status: Enabled and added 30-day noncurrent version expiration lifecycle rule.

Asynchronous Lambda functions and SQS consumers have configured DLQs (e.g., ResumeScoringDLQ with maxReceiveCount: 3). Failed events are persisted to FailedJobsTable for redrive and manual intervention.

trusted_advisor.check: AWS Step Functions Workflow Retries & Catches
trusted_advisor.details: Both Step Functions state machines (SLAMS Leave Approval & Smart Onboarding) include explicit Retry definitions with exponential backoff (BackoffRate: 2.0) and Catch handlers for States.Timeout, States.TaskFailed, and transient network errors.
